title: Business Systems Analyst - Oracle Fusion, ERP, Supply Chain & Manufacturing - 5 to 10 Yrs , BLR
teaser: Join us as a Business Systems Analyst to design, configure, and optimise Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM modules, supporting global supply chain operations. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable solutions. Ideal for candidates with strong Oracle Fusion expertise and experience in manufacturing and supply chain processes.
description:
The application window is expected to close on: 08/19/2026
Job posting may be removed earlier if the position is filled or if a sufficient number of applications are received.

Meet the Team 

Cisco IT is a transformation engine enabling people to do the best work of their lives! Our vision is to be loved as the world’s best IT organization. We lead with user experience, accept agile ways of working, drive engineering efficiency, and deliver with Cloud first, shift left, AI powered technology.

The Component Operations Supply Chain IT team is at the forefront of redefining our supply chain through technology. We specialize in implementing and optimizing our Supply Chain ERP solution, a critical backbone for managing everything from procurement to delivery. Our expertise ensures seamless integration of processes, providing real-time transparencynd control over our entire supply chain operations. We empower data-driven decisions that enhance efficiency, reduce costs, and improve overall operational agility. 

Your Impact:

The Oracle Fusion Solution Analyst for Supply Chain & Manufacturing is responsible for designing, configuring, and optimizing Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM modules—specifically Inventory, Order Management, Manufacturing, Planning, Procurement, and Costing. This role partners with business customers, architects, and technical teams to deliver scalable, high‑quality solutions that support global supply chain operations, manufacturing processes, and enterprise transformation initiatives.

Responsibilities:

Solution Design & Configuration

Translate business requirements into functional designs across Fusion SCM modules.

Configure Oracle Fusion setups for Inventory, Manufacturing, Work Definitions, Cost Management, OM, Procurement, and Planning.

Participate in the design end‑to‑end flows: Order‑to‑Cash, procure‑to‑Pay, Plan‑to‑Produce, and Cost‑to‑Report.

Business Process Optimization

Analyze current supply chain and manufacturing processes; identify gaps and improvement opportunities.

Recommend best‑practice configurations aligned with Oracle Cloud capabilities.

Implementation & Enhancements

Lead module configurations, testing cycles (SIT/UAT), and production deployments.

Support quarterly Oracle Cloud updates—impact analysis, regression testing, and rollout.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

Work closely with manufacturing, supply chain, logistics, procurement, finance, and IT teams.

Collaborate with technical developers for integrations, extensions, and reports.

Production Support

Solve functional issues, perform root‑cause analysis, and drive resolution.

Handle service requests (SRs) with Oracle Support and ensure timely closure.

Documentation & Governance

Develop User stories, acceptance criteria and test scenarios

Develop functional design documents (FDDs), configuration workbooks, test scripts, and SOPs.

Ensure compliance with IT controls, audit requirements, and change management processes.

Data & Reporting

Support data migration activities—templates, validation, reconciliation.

Work with BI teams to define OTBI, BIP, and dashboards for SCM and manufacturing KPIs.

Minimum Qualifications:

Education - Bachelors + 5 years of related experience, or Masters +2 years of related experience

Core Functional Expertise

5–7 years of experience in Oracle Fusion Cloud SCM or E‑Business Suite SCM.

Configuration experience in Manufacturing and Supply chain modules

Solid understanding of manufacturing processes: discrete, process, work definitions, routings, resources, costing.

Technical & Integration Skills

Ability to write functional specifications for:

REST/SOAP integrations

BIP/OTBI reports

FBDI templates

Integration error handling and troubleshooting

Redwood UI and security/privilege concepts

Business & Analytical Skills

Strong process mapping skills (Visio, Lucidchart).

Ability to translate business difficulties into system solutions.

Experience with global supply chain operations, multi‑org setups, and master data governance.

Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies.

Soft Skills

Good communication and customer management.

Strong documentation.

Ability to work in fast‑paced, multi‑project environments.

Problem‑solving attitude with ownership and accountability.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with Oracle Fusion Planning, Quality, Maintenance, or IoT modules

Exposure in manufacturing industries (high‑tech, automotive, industrial, consumer goods)

Understanding of Oracle Cloud architecture, security roles, workflows, and approval rules

Exposure to multi‑cloud integrations (OCI/AWS)

Understanding of B2B/A2A integrations (OIC, EDI, B2B gateways, WMS ERP integrations)

Experience with Project Management tools like Jira, Monday.com and Smartsheet.

Familiarity with AI-Enabled Efficiency and Planning Tools.

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
